entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is 551-9B-42K.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see an order for the Pro-Frame Helmet. Can I get your name to verify the account?
Sam Jones. Look, I'm a bit short on time. Can this be returned or not?
I understand, Mr. Jones. I just need to ask a quick clarifying question. What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color is off, it's not what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened.
I see. Getting the right color is definitely important, both for style and for on-road safety and visibility. Let me just check the delivery date here.
Just tell me yes or no.
Yes, you can absolutely return it. According to our policy, standard items like this helmet are eligible for return within 90 days. You are well within that window.
Great. That's what I needed to hear. What's next?
I've just approved the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and you're all set.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
